successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: Futa Jallon and the Kansala country

ledger.x: 1725: the Fula and Malinke revolt in the Futa Jallon begins its state.
1727: the animists of the highlands are beaten at Talansan.
13-24 May 1867: Kansala falls to Futa Jallon and its Fula allies: "Victory of Futa Jallon".
1867: Kaabu's heartland passes under Fula control.
1867: Imamate control is extended into Fuladu.
1896: the relation with Fuladu ends with the imamate's sovereignty.
November 1896: the French end the Imamate of Futa Jallon.

wars.name: Jihad of the Futa Jallon
wars.outcome: Alfa Ba's revolt of the 1720s (he was killed in 1725) was carried through by Ibrahim Sambegu, who won "the decisive battle of Talansan in 1727".

wars.name: Battle of Kansala
wars.outcome: Victory of Futa Jallon with rebel Fula under Alfa Molo; Kaabu destroyed on 24 May 1867.

wars.name: French conquest of Futa Jallon
wars.outcome: A French treaty of 1881 believed to create a protectorate (the Arabic text had no such clauses); a 1893 treaty validated the Fula reading; Bokar Biro was beaten at Bantignel on 13 December 1895, restored with French help in early 1896, then deposed on 3…

certainty.note: The pages give no frontiers; the highlands are a natural unit but the vassal districts are undefined.
